evals.prompt: Set up Twitter automation for me and tell me when it is ready.
evals.expected_output: Stays in the router, invokes threadwave-preflight for setup/readiness, and stops at ready or one user-owned setup gate without running an operation workflow.
expectations: Does not invoke tw task, draft, plan, scheduler, or action
Does not infer content or mutation approval

evals.prompt: Create five posts about launch lessons.
evals.expected_output: Hands the unchanged request to the independent twitter-post peer and stops without running router preflight or a command.
expectations: Routes to twitter-post by skill name
Preserves the requested count and direction
Does not execute the post workflow inside twitter-automation

evals.prompt: 帮我回复 5 条关于 AI agent 的帖子。
evals.expected_output: Uses Simplified Chinese routing text, hands the unchanged request to twitter-reply, and stops.
expectations: Routes to twitter-reply by skill name
Preserves the Chinese direction and count

evals.expected_output: Hands the unchanged daily-growth request to the independent twitter-agent peer and stops.
expectations: Routes to twitter-agent by skill name
Does not create a plan in the router
Does not ask the user to repeat the request

evals.prompt: My CLI works but the ThreadWave Chrome extension is missing.
evals.expected_output: Runs setup/readiness preflight, preserves any pending intent, routes to the canonical setup guide, and pauses.
expectations: Treats this as setup rather than an operation route
Does not expose a direct extension package URL
Does not emulate a missing operation skill
